scope: Plan-only review and refactor of the proposed Gaya dataset workpackage contracts; no implementation, enrollment, registration or acceptance claims
authority: KAD-bounded documentation review; not a native workctl claim
review_findings: Frames 01–08 owned mixed roots: nested kad-rpg code paths plus workspace evidence paths that cannot be claimed together under one native project claim.
Frame 04 consumed frame 03 resolved entity IDs without declaring the dependency; the visual chain was incorrectly parallel to the knowledge chain.
Frame 00 steps directed it to register tasks and resolve enrollment, effects outside its evidence-only owned scope.
Every frame embedded a model/provider transport string ('Gemini 3.8 Flash…') in the contract, contrary to model-neutral work definitions.
Frame 01 required the complete inspect/run/verify/replay CLI while later frames implemented its stages; intermediate acceptance was not bounded.
Frame 02 acceptance allowed representative probes as evidence of a full census; ISA requires complete source accounting.
The pasted TODO in the handoff delivery relabeled frames as ingestion/normalization and reported 1/10, conflicting with the canonical 00–09 IDs.

The release layout implied qualification results inside the sealed payload while the ISA also requires an authorized acceptance receipt; the hash-recipient order was under-specified and risked circular final checks.

The ISA acceptance matrix assigns GAYA-G1-01 to frames 00–02, but frame 01 did not list it as an evidence contribution although it defines the disposition schema carrying that gate's manifest evidence.
Frames 07/08 accepted blocked preconditions implicitly; native workctl requires ACCEPTED blockers and a BLOCKED frame cannot advance merely because partial artifacts exist.
changes_applied: Added shared execution_policy: builder role transport-neutral; path bases; evidence ownership; native registration mapping; dependency semantics; acceptance semantics; scope resolution before registration.
Normalized frame owned_paths to project-relative (kad-rpg for 01–08, workspace for 00/09); nested receipt staging first, separately authorized workspace evidence copies.
Corrected the DAG: 03 → 04 → 05, with 04 declaring entity/seed inputs from 03.
Rebounded frame 00 to a read-only preflight evidence frame with a prerequisite decision table; enrollment/registration are external authority effects.
Added per-frame entry_conditions tying progress to accepted native dependencies, including observed admission for fresh local synthesis without waiving the ISA requirement.
Bounded frame 01 to real inspect plus fail-closed dispatch; per-frame stage completion responsibilities for run/verify/replay across 02–08.
Strengthened frame 02 to full per-source deterministic extraction receipts with mutually exclusive terminal dispositions and distinct reason codes.
Clarified non-recursive release sealing: external authorized acceptance receipts bind to the sealed manifest hash and live outside the payload hash set; final native check consumes the receipt.
Added GAYA-G1-01 to frame 01 gates to satisfy the ISA acceptance matrix owner-frames.
Updated PROMPT-GEMINI-BUILDER.md and ISA-GAYA-DATASET-G1-001.md in alignment: project-scoped ownership, sequential frames, staged CLI, acceptance receipt order, change log entries.
preserved: All ten frame IDs WP-GAYA-DATASET-G1-00..09 and titles.
